description: Build a robots.txt from per-category choices (allow, block or omit for training, dataset, search, user_fetch or other), optional per-token overrides, a default policy for other bots, paths, sitemaps and custom rules. Returns the file text, a per-crawler summary and notes. Read-only: it only returns text and changes nothing. Same engine as POST /api/generate.

agents.description: Per-token overrides, e.g. {"GPTBot": "block"}. Tokens: letters, digits, "_", "." and "-", up to 64 characters (not "*"). At most 100.

allow_paths.description: Paths to allow explicitly. Each path starts with "/" or "*" and has no whitespace or "#". At most 100.

categories.description: Action per crawler category. Omitted categories get no group of their own.

custom_rules.description: Extra robots.txt lines appended after validation (max 20000 bytes).

date.description: Date for the header comment (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (UTC).

disallow_paths.description: Paths to disallow for "*" and for allowed AI groups. Each path starts with "/" or "*" and has no whitespace or "#". At most 100.

sitemap.description: A single sitemap URL (alternative to sitemaps).

sitemaps.description: Absolute http(s) sitemap URLs. At most 20.

name: generate_robots
title: Generate a robots.txt for AI crawlers
